name: oracle-tree-inventory
argv: set -u; O=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/corpus/evidence/round-44/oracle; cd "$O"; find . -path "./*/__output__/*" -type f | sort | while read -r f; do printf "%s  %s\n" "$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d" " -f1)" "${f#./}"; done > /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv; cat /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv; echo "-- counts --"; awk "{n++; s+=\$0}" /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv >/dev/null; mem=$(wc -l < /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv); tot=0; while read -r _ p; do b=$(stat -c%s "$p"); tot=$((tot+b)); done < /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv; dis=$(cut -d" " -f1 /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv | sort -u | wc -l); printf "member_files=%s total_bytes=%s distinct_sha256=%s\n" "$mem" "$tot" "$dis"; echo "-- tree digest --"; sha256sum /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv; echo "-- non-member files at oracle root --"; find . -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort
argv_shell: bash -c 'set -u; O=/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/kaidoku-shokunin/corpus/evidence/round-44/oracle; cd "$O"; find . -path "./*/__output__/*" -type f | sort | while read -r f; do printf "%s  %s\n" "$(sha256sum "$f" | cut -d" " -f1)" "${f#./}"; done > /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv; cat /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv; echo "-- counts --"; awk "{n++; s+=\$0}" /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv >/dev/null; mem=$(wc -l < /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv); tot=0; while read -r _ p; do b=$(stat -c%s "$p"); tot=$((tot+b)); done < /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv; dis=$(cut -d" " -f1 /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv | sort -u | wc -l); printf "member_files=%s total_bytes=%s distinct_sha256=%s\n" "$mem" "$tot" "$dis"; echo "-- tree digest --"; sha256sum /tmp/probe-R44SrcOracle-tree.tsv; echo "-- non-member files at oracle root --"; find . -maxdepth 1 -type f | sort'
note: inventory of the pre-freeze oracle tree: member files only (manifest.json excluded), per-file sha256, totals, and the sorted tree digest that content-addresses the frozen set; oracle-tree.tsv beside the receipts is byte-identical input to the digest
